_metadata.purpose: B-NEW-42b ex-dividend curated calendar (interim posture). 1-2h pre-market-open block (7:30-9:30 ET on ex-date) for 15 known dividend-paying xStock symbols. Replaces Phase D auto-calendar feed (Yahoo Finance) at handover. See SYSTEM_MANUAL.md → Trading Halts → Ex-Dividend Curated Calendar.
_metadata.source: Estimated ex-dividend dates Q3 + Q4 2026 based on each company's historical declaration cadence. NOT a guarantee — symbols' actual schedules can shift; this is interim defense before Yahoo Finance auto-feed lands in Phase D.
_metadata.refresh_cadence: Manually refresh quarterly; each refresh batch hand-schedules next refresh alert via the system-alerts queue (see RUNNING_ISSUES #112).
